values.note: $30 a night at the four sites away from the shore (26, 32, 35, 36), $34 at the 32 waterfront (WF) singles; the six WF double sites are $68. The same on a Saturday in November 2026 and June 2027 and on a June 2027 weekday. One rate for everyone. $10 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: Bartow County WebTrac 'Old Highway' search for 2027-06-15 (4 sites '$30.00', 32 '$34.00', 6 doubles '$68.00'), the same on 2027-06-19 and 2026-11-14; Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 ('ALL CANCELLATIONS WILL INCUR A $10.00 CANCELLATION FEE'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: Bartow County WebTrac Old Highway 41 #3, every site ('Standard Electric Site: Accommodates 30 & 50 Amp', 'Water Hookups', 'Dump Station on Site, No Sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 42 rentals: 36 single sites and 6 doubles (1/2, 3/4, 17/18, 28/29, 37/38, 49/50), all water and 30/50-amp electric; 38 are waterfront (WF). Driveways 21-50 ft; 20 (22 ft) and 23 (21 ft) are too short for a 23-ft rig. Pull-throughs 39, 40, 41 and 48.

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245 (Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 8-4). Senior/Access pass holders call the office to add the pass before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days at county campgrounds, then away 16 days. Check-in 3 pm; gate closed 10:30 pm - 7 am.

note: Bartow County Parks & Recreation campground on a peninsula in USACE Allatoona Lake (Acworth), formerly Corps-run. Boat ramp, playground. --Claude
